title: AnyMo: Geometry-Aware Setup-Agnostic Modeling of Human Motion in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2605.22715v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As wearable and mobile devices become increasingly embedded in daily life, they offer a practical way to continuously sense human motion in the wild. But inertial signals are highly dependent on the sensing setup, including body location, mounting position, sensor orientation, device hardware, and sampling protocol. This setup dependence makes it difficult to learn motion representations that transfer across devices and datasets, and limits the broader use of wearable IMUs beyond closed-set recognition. We introduce AnyMo, a geometry-aware framework for setup-agnostic human motion modeling. AnyMo uses physics-grounded IMU simulation over dense body-surface placements to generate diverse and plausible synthetic signals, pre-trains a graph encoder from paired synthetic placement views and masked partial observations, tokenizes multi-position IMU into full-body motion tokens, and aligns these tokens with an LLM for motion-language

translated_title: AnyMo：几何感知、与传感配置无关的真实场景人体运动建模
translated_abstract: 随着可穿戴和移动设备日益融入日常生活，它们为在真实场景中持续感知人体运动提供了实用的途径。但惯性信号高度依赖于传感配置，包括身体佩戴位置、安装方式、传感器朝向、设备硬件和采样协议。这种对配置的依赖使得难以学习能够跨设备和跨数据集迁移的运动表示，也限制了可穿戴IMU在封闭集识别之外的更广泛应用。我们提出AnyMo，一个用于与传感配置无关的人体运动建模的几何感知框架。AnyMo利用基于物理的IMU仿真在密集的身体表面位置上生成多样且合理的合成信号，从配对的合成佩戴位置视图和掩码部分观测中预训练图编码器，将多位置IMU数据标记化为全身运动token，并将这些token与LLM对齐以实现运动-语言（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AnyMo提出了一种几何感知的框架，通过基于物理的IMU仿真、配对位置视图与掩码观测预训练图编码器、将多位置IMU数据转化为全身运动token并与LLM对齐，实现了不依赖传感器配置（佩戴位置、朝向、硬件等）的人体运动建模。
en_tdlr: AnyMo introduces a geometry-aware framework that achieves setup-agnostic human motion modeling by leveraging physics-based IMU simulation, pre-training a graph encoder with paired placement views and masked observations, and tokenizing multi-position IMU signals into full-body motion tokens aligned with LLMs.
